tool_input.description: Probe error cases and edge behaviors

result: Created `src/test/org/apache/commons/lang/time/DateUtilsAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 3.8-style (`TestCase`) test class matching the project's convention and 1.6 source level. It covers `isSameDay`, `isSameInstant`, `isSameLocalTime` (including the HOUR-vs-HOUR_OF_DAY/AM_PM quirk where 1am/1pm are treated as equal), `parseDate` (multi-pattern fallback, partial-match failure, nulls), all `add*` helpers plus immutability checks, `round`/`truncate` for `Date`/`Calendar`/`Object` overloads (including `SEMI_MONTH`, unsupported-field `IllegalArgumentException`, oversized-year `ArithmeticException`, bad-type `ClassCastException`), the `iterator` overloads for every range style plus the inner `DateIterator`'s `remove()`/exhausted-`next()` behavior, and the public constants/constructor. All 46 tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`, and the rest of the suite still passes.
